storage_decision: Existing schema 11 and frozen run-output v1 can retain the complete accumulated path without schema, codec, enum, migration, or meaning changes.

stage_to_output.scope-case: supported_cases or lead_only_cases according to finding linkage

provenance.retained_stage_origin: The exact historical producer and originating run remain unchanged.
provenance.current_composition_edge: The current run adds only a consuming-run evidence edge.
provenance.provider_replay: Historical LLM involvement remains visible while every current provider, model, credential, DNS, network, billable, live, and source-refresh effect is not-used.

semantic_fields: typed artifacts, revisions, types, states, payload classes, provenance relationship labels, and LLM involvement
taxonomy subject relationships, axes, facets, codes, applicability, classification roles, evidence, conditions, confidence, reasons, and provenance
coverage populations, denominators, completion, states, taxonomy links, gaps, exclusions, and failures
run state, collection states, capability exclusions, readiness, replay class, auditability, and no-effect boundaries
run_instance_fields: run ID, start and end timestamps, CLI summary fingerprint, replay manifest, dependency-manifest artifact ID, and diagnostic trace references
current-run-derived identity hashes normalized to typed relationship labels
current originating-run IDs and consuming-run provenance edges
